name: Flow
description:
Flow: Focus & Pomodoro Timer
Concentration for work & study

Simplify your day, one Flow at a time.
Flow helps you take control of your workflow, reduce stress, boost productivity, and focus on what matters most.

Be more productive with a better workflow
Flow structures your work into short intervals with recurring breaks in between.

Overview your progress
Every flow counts. Small steps add up over time. Flow visualizes your productivity trends.

Maintain your focus by blocking distractions
From social media to email, there are many things that steal our attention.

Beautiful design and native development
Flow has a minimalistic, unobtrusive design so you can focus on your tasks.

_______________

Can I use Flow for free?
You sure can. Flow offers a free version that includes all the essential features of a focus timer. If you’re looking for advanced features, we also offer a free trial period of our ‘Pro’ plan.
